title: Ex Vivo Human Skin Explants as a Pharmacological Multi-Parameter Platform to Investigate Environmental Stress Responses and Topical Intervention Efficacy
content: This study supports the use of human skin explants as a versatile and translational model for evaluating pharmacologic skin responses and topical bioactivity. The approach allows mechanistic insight beyond single biomarkers and may serve as a scalable pharmacologic platform for efficacy testing, particularly when expanded to include multiple donors and broader readouts.
